`ssd_unet_config.json` is the unchanged U-Net config from
[segmind/SSD-1B](https://huggingface.co/segmind/SSD-1B/blob/60987f37e94cd59c36b1cba832b9f97b57395a10/unet/config.json),
revision `60987f37e94cd59c36b1cba832b9f97b57395a10` (Apache 2.0).
The offline meta-device test checks SSD's topology without downloading weights.
